seo.title: Ambi Fitness Club | 24-Hour Gym in Al Qusais, Dubai, from AED 199
seo.description: Women-owned 24-hour gym in Al Qusais: personal training, Zumba, CrossFit sessions, kids' aerobics and diet plans. Memberships from AED 199. 4.9 from 292 Google reviews.
